info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Card Management API
info.description: The Credit Card Management API allows businesses to update and manage credit card details efficiently. Utilizing this API, users can modify various attributes of their existing credit cards, such as limits, account status, and other relevant settings. It serves as an essential tool for financial institutions and service providers in maintaining up-to-date information for their customers. Typical consumers include banks, payment processors, and financial management applications aiming for enhanced user account capabilities.

patch.summary: Update a credit card by its ID.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific credit card identified by its unique ID. Provide the necessary fields to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the properties of a credit card identified by CARD-400045. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields to modify the card's details. Only the fields that need to be updated should be included in the request.

200.description: The credit card information was successfully updated.
